what: Leakage audit of the scan grouping using upstream raw-slice zero-padding counts (images/sample/{i}.png, pixels == 0), collected for all 1,745 verified slices in the browser session.
finding_signature_quality: The zero-padding count is a scanner/protocol signature, not a patient id: the value 55,772 occurs in 13 separate index runs and 56,252 in 7; many scans have no padding, so the count varies slice to slice. It therefore cannot replace the tumour-run reconstruction, but runs of identical padding are a useful audit: a run crossing a split boundary could be one scan split across splits.
impact: Task A (tumour vs tumour-free liver patches; all compared models) uses tumour slices only - unaffected. The liver-tissue gate uses some no-liver slices; at most 12 such slices near two group boundaries could share a scan across splits.
other_evidence: Upstream slices 100-233 share one padding value (55,772 / mode 84), consistent with run G01-R1 (100-215) being a single scan (the conservative grouping keeps it whole).
